package.description: C++ program to generate waveform data and render waveform images from audio files

en-US.description: C++ program to generate waveform data and render waveform images from audio files
en-US.longDescription: audiowaveform is a C++ command-line application that generates waveform data from either MP3, WAV, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, or Opus format audio files. Waveform data can be used to produce a visual rendering of the audio, similar in appearance to audio editing applications.
en-US.name: Audio Waveform Image Generator
